operator_eli5_summary.how_openclaw_decides_build_now_vs_hold: OpenClaw checks whether an idea already has enough safe context and a named rail. If it does, it can become a bounded work packet or read-model lane. If it is vague, early, risky, or missing proof, it is held, parked, or blocked instead of guessed.
next_1_to_3_sensible_lanes: Chief Domain Overlap Segmentation Review v0
operator_eli5_summary.what_can_safely_become_a_work_packet: Requests with a clear rail, safe metadata context, no forbidden authority, and a bounded next-safe move.
operator_eli5_summary.what_gets_parked: Deferred ideas, vague cues, memory-dependent ideas, missing-context requests, and items waiting for proof.
operator_eli5_summary.what_is_blocked_on_purpose: Items are blocked on purpose when they require execution, sends, shell, LLM/Ollama calls, planner/builder automation, repair loops, credentials, browser/Coupa, or client deployment.
operator_eli5_summary.what_still_needs_future_security_live_au: Live execution, automation loops, protected broker/PII work, external sends/submits, and client deployment.
